rule_or_requirement: A faster launch must preserve a pixel-only finite three-action package and retain the qualified-finish objective.
observable_information: The selected driver's action, seven visible road-center rows, obstacle detection, and image-derived speed from the four grayscale frames.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Only during the first at most 18 decisions, raise gas to 0.45 while the opening road is visible, centered, straight and clear; permanently return to selected base control on the first speed, bend, obstacle, steering, braking, visibility, or decision-limit exit signal.
expected_success_endpoint: A frozen local ZIP containing the exact selected control files plus the registered launch wrapper, ready for separate matched finish-line comparison; the eventual target is no completion loss and shorter initial and finished lap time.
falsifier: The wrapper is absent, frozen input hashes differ, forbidden package content appears, invalid actions occur, or the launch gate never changes gas on an eligible starting straight.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Build one exact ZIP with static inventory and source-hash checks; use a separately registered local comparison to measure first-10-percent and actual finished laps.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local packaging profile with a 600-second limit and 500 MB ZIP limit; no driving, training, site upload, official submission, or model confirmation in this run.
